Strategy: Apply the sweet-band reward between thirty and forty-five only when at least five bins are open, keeping the mid penalty always on. This combination improved results on two other seeds by reserving steering for crowded states, but the gate may rarely engage and the threshold is a guess.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
